title: No Block
smart_description: You cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold] from cards for {Amount:plural:[blue]{}[/blue] turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}.
notes: Debuff that prevents the afflicted creature from gaining Block from cards. Uses a Counter stack type, decrementing by 1 after each enemy turn until expiration. The {Amount} in smartDescription represents the remaining counter value.
